    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractDAO<T>
    Generic Data Access Object (DAO) implementing common database operations (CRUD).
    Bill
    An immutable data record representing a finalized order financial invoice (Bill).
    BillDAO
    Data Access Object (DAO) class specifically designed for handling operations on the Bill entity.
    BillFrame
    Presentation Layer window designed to display historical commercial invoices (Bills).
    Client
    Model class representing a Client entity within the warehouse application.
    ClientBLL
    Business Logic Layer class for handling operations related to Clients.
    ClientDAO
    Data Access Object (DAO) class for managing persistent operations related to the Client entity.
    ClientFrame
    Presentation Layer window dedicated to executing CRUD operations on Clients.
    ClientValidator
    Validator implementation dedicated to checking data constraints for Client instances.
    ConnectionFactory
    Singleton Factory class responsible for managing database connection lifecycles.
    Main
     
    MainFrame
    Presentation Layer class representing the primary dashboard window of the application.
    Order
    Model class representing an Order entity within the warehouse management system.
    OrderBLL
    Business Logic Layer class for handling operations related to Orders.
    OrderDAO
    Data Access Object (DAO) class for managing persistent operations related to the Order entity.
    OrderFrame
    Presentation Layer window designed to process commercial warehouse order operations.
    OrderValidator
    Validator implementation dedicated to checking structural constraints for commercial Order entries.
    Product
    Model class representing a Product stock entity within the warehouse.
    ProductBLL
    Business Logic Layer class for handling operations related to Products.
    ProductDAO
    Data Access Object (DAO) class for managing persistent operations related to the Product entity.
    ProductFrame
    Presentation Layer window dedicated to executing CRUD operations on warehouse Products inventory.
    ProductValidator
    Validator implementation dedicated to checking data constraints for Product instances.
    ReflectionTableModel
    Presentation Layer utility class designed to dynamically map data object domains into Swing GUI table models.
    Validator<T>
    A generic Functional Interface designed to validate application data models before persistent operations.
